segments.name: North American Towable Recreational Vehicles
segments.description: Manufactures conventional travel trailers and fifth wheels for North American customers through Airstream (towable), Jayco (towable), Keystone and KZ.
segments.evidence: The North American Towable Recreational Vehicles reportable segment consists of the following operating segments that have been aggregated: Airstream (towable), Jayco (towable), Keystone and KZ.

segments.name: North American Motorized Recreational Vehicles
segments.description: Manufactures gasoline and diesel Class A, Class C and Class B motorhomes through Airstream (motorized), Jayco (motorized), Thor Motor Coach and Tiffin Motorhomes.
segments.evidence: The North American Motorized Recreational Vehicles reportable segment consists of the following operating segments that have been aggregated: Airstream (motorized), Jayco (motorized), Thor Motor Coach and Tiffin Motorhomes.

segments.name: European Recreational Vehicles
segments.description: Manufactures motorized and towable recreational vehicles in Europe through the Erwin Hymer Group, sold primarily within Europe.
segments.evidence: The European Recreational Vehicles reportable segment consists solely of the EHG business.

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Includes Airxcel and Postle, which supply RV-related products and components to RV manufacturers and aftermarket customers.
segments.evidence: The operations of the Company's Airxcel and Postle subsidiaries are included in "Other" in Note 2 to the Consolidated Financial Statements.

revenueModel.text: The company sells RVs and related parts and accessories primarily to independent, non-franchise dealers in the United States, Canada and Europe, generally producing vehicles to dealer order.
revenueModel.evidence: We manufacture a wide variety of recreational vehicles in the United States and Europe and sell those vehicles, as well as related parts and accessories, primarily to independent, non-franchise dealers throughout the United States, Canada and Europe.
